_comment: THE SINGLE REGISTER OF LABS. One fact, one place.
The same numbers used to live in three files and two were wrong, which made every hand-in
flag NOT ALL QUESTIONS and broke completion codes above the stated total.
stations/questions are written by each lab's own tools/build.mjs — do not edit them by
hand, they will be overwritten. Everything else is edited here.
store   the localStorage key the lab keeps its progress under. It is NOT always <id>.v2:
the Classification Lab uses .v1. Always read it from here.
shelf   which hub the lab sits behind, so progress can be rolled up.
node tools/status.mjs reports anything that disagrees with this file.
